Purpose
A vapour header where the fresh A, D and E
feeds, the stripper overhead gas and the
compressed recycle gas mix before flowing on
to the reactor as the reactor feed (stream 6).
Flow control: each fresh feed has its own
control valve; everything mixes in one header.

labels.text:
Purpose
The agitated reactor where A, C, D and E react
to the products G and H (with F as a
byproduct); cooling water removes the heat of
reaction, and the products leave as vapour
with the unreacted gas (stream 7).
Heat removal: cooling water carries the heat
of reaction away; the products leave as
vapour.

labels.text:
Purpose
The condenser that cools the reactor effluent
with cooling water on its way to the
separator; the simulator has no separate
condenser vessel and adds this cooling to the
separator's energy balance.
Vapour in, cooled stream out: cooling water
takes the heat (the simulator counts it in the
separator).

labels.text:
Purpose
The vapour-liquid separator that splits the
cooled effluent: vapour goes to the recycle
compressor or out through the purge (streams 8
and 9), and the condensed liquid goes to the
stripper (stream 10).
Phase split: vapour goes to the compressor or
the purge; liquid holds a level and goes to
the stripper.

Purpose
The compressor that returns separator vapour
to the reactor feed header as recycle gas
(stream 8); its recycle valve spills some flow
back around the machine.
Pressure boost: raises the recycle gas from
separator to header pressure; a recycle valve
spills some back.

labels.text:
Purpose
The steam-heated stripper that uses the A and
C feed (stream 4) to strip most of the lighter
components (A to F) out of the separator
liquid, sending them overhead to the feed
header (stream 5) while the heavy products G
and H leave the bottom as product (stream 11).
Gas rises, liquid falls: the stripped gas
returns to the feed header and steam heats the
column.
